blocks.orig: Treat your family to the adventure of a lifetime – during an unforgettable family holiday in Tanzania. Your kids can see how the animals from their picture books come alive, and you can relax knowing that Tanzania is a safe and family-friendly holiday destination.
blocks.html: Treat your family to an adventure they will never forget: a family holiday in Tanzania. Your children watch the creatures from their storybooks come alive, while you can unwind knowing the country is a safe and welcoming destination for families.

blocks.orig: Yes, of course. In Tanzania, your kids can see how the animals from their picture books come alive, and you can relax knowing that Tanzania is a safe and family-friendly holiday destination. Our guides love children and have fun telling them gripping stories about nature, the Big Five and lion cubs – just as in the Lion King.
blocks.html: Absolutely. In Tanzania the animals from your children’s picture books come to life before their eyes, and you can relax in the knowledge that Tanzania is a safe, family-friendly destination. Our guides are fond of children and enjoy telling them exciting stories about nature, the Big Five and lion cubs – just like in the Lion King.

blocks.orig: Upon creating your trip, we make sure that we organize it for your kids AND for you so that you can all enjoy it to the fullest. Depending on your situation, it means: shorter safari days and more time to enjoy the pool, children seats in the car, with extra snacks and Wi-Fi. Also, we carefully select accommodations with special facilities for your little ones, like pools, activities, or even nannies.
blocks.html: When we put your trip together, we plan it for your children AND for you, so that everyone gets the most out of it. Depending on your situation that can mean shorter safari days with more time at the pool, child seats in the car, extra snacks and Wi-Fi. We also pick accommodation with special facilities for the little ones, such as pools, activities or even nannies.

blocks.orig: There is no minimum age to enter Tanzanian national parks. As long as your kids are under the age of 15, you even pay a lower entry fee for them. But just to give you an idea: most families who book a family-friendly safari with us have kids who are at least six years old. If you think that your kid is still a little too young for a long safari, a few safari days followed by a trip to Zanzibar could be the best option. Or you simply wait one, two, or three more years – Tanzania will be waiting for you.
blocks.html: Tanzanian national parks have no minimum age, and for children under 15 you even pay a reduced entry fee. To give you some idea, though: most families who book a family-friendly safari with us travel with children aged six or older. If you feel your child is still a bit young for a long safari, a few days on safari followed by Zanzibar might be the best choice. Or you simply wait another one, two or three years – Tanzania isn’t going anywhere.

blocks.orig: If you plan a family holiday in Tanzania with kids, best check with your doctor or health office regarding recommended vaccinations and medication. It’s also advisable to take out additional Flying Doctors insurance. If something happens (knock on wood it won’t), a helicopter can transport you to the nearest hospital straight away.
blocks.html: When planning a family holiday in Tanzania with children, it is wise to ask your doctor or health office about recommended vaccinations and medication. Taking out extra Flying Doctors insurance is also advisable. Should anything happen (touch wood it won’t), a helicopter can fly you to the nearest hospital right away.

blocks.orig: Yes, babies are welcome! With us, you travel in your own, private 4×4 landcruiser which allows you to be flexible and have some privacy. Your little one can rest in their baby seat (ask your travel consultant to book one for you!) while you are enjoying the views. Our safari jeeps are often also equipped with a fridge for milk etc. and if you let us know special dietary wishes of your little ones beforehand, we can accommodate them as well. Also, let us know if you need a baby bed in the lodges… we’ll arrange that for you.
blocks.html: Yes, babies are more than welcome! You travel with us in your own private 4×4 landcruiser, which gives you flexibility and privacy. Your little one can sleep in a baby seat (ask your travel consultant to book one!) while you take in the views. Many of our safari jeeps also have a fridge for milk and the like, and if you tell us about your children’s special dietary needs in advance, we can cater for those too. Need a cot in the lodges? Just say so… we will sort it out.

blocks.orig: Of course, you can rent a car seat simply by contacting your travel consultant. We want to make sure that you can travel comfortably with your kids, with baby or booster seats that can be rented for the safari cars. Please make sure to reserve your baby seat before your arrival, for your kids’ safety and comfort during the safari (price on request).
blocks.html: Certainly: a car seat can be hired simply by asking your travel consultant. We want you and your children to travel in comfort, so baby and booster seats are available to rent for the safari cars. For your children’s safety and comfort on safari, please book your baby seat before you arrive (price on request).

blocks.orig: In general, lodges love children, but not all lodges offer the same services for the little ones – some only have a few. In some lodges, you might find supervised playgrounds, animation teams or nanny services, while others just offer a swimming pool and a kids’ menu. Some of these services are complimentary, for others you have to pay extra. Your consultant is happy to inform you about the options and help you to make the best choice!
blocks.html: Lodges generally love having children, but the services for little ones vary a lot – some only have a few. Some lodges offer supervised playgrounds, animation teams or nanny services, while others simply have a swimming pool and a children’s menu. Some of these services are free, others cost extra. Your consultant will gladly explain the options and help you choose what suits you best!

blocks.orig: Because it’s all about the right preparation…
blocks.html: Because good preparation makes all the difference…

blocks.orig: Book accommodation with a swimming pool: kids have a lot of energy and need to have fun after a safari day.
blocks.html: Choose accommodation with a swimming pool: children have plenty of energy and want to let off steam after a day on safari.

blocks.orig: Check with your doctor which vaccinations or medications they might need, and don’t forget to take an insurance as well.
blocks.html: Ask your doctor which vaccinations or medication they may need, and remember to arrange insurance too.

blocks.orig: Packing only needs a good system! Pick out the outfits at home and pack them into the suitcase as a set – underwear, socks, t-shirt, trousers, skirt, jumper, etc. If you stack all of these clothes on top of each other and then roll them up, you can save a lot of space. Each morning, take out the next outfit, wrinkle-free! Put the dirty clothes in a separate bag, done!
blocks.html: A good system makes packing simple! Choose each day’s outfit at home and put it into the case as a complete set – underwear, socks, t-shirt, trousers, skirt, jumper and so on. Lay the items on top of one another and roll them up, and you save a surprising amount of room. Every morning you grab the next set, no creases! Worn clothes go into a separate bag, and you’re done.

blocks.orig: Bring snacks and drinks, or order special snacks and drinks with us, so that no one of you gets hangry during the adventure.
blocks.html: Take snacks and drinks with you, or ask us to arrange special ones, so nobody in the group gets hangry along the way.

blocks.orig: Bring some toys or order Wi-Fi in the car in case your kids get a little bored.
blocks.html: Take along a few toys, or order Wi-Fi in the car, for the moments your children get a bit bored.

blocks.orig: Diaper bags are handy if you have to change nappies but don’t have a bin somewhere close.
blocks.html: Nappy bags come in handy when you need to change a nappy and there is no bin nearby.

blocks.orig: Don’t forget sunscreen and insect repellant – that’s always important, no matter if you travel with or without kids.
blocks.html: Remember sunscreen and insect repellent – always essential, whether you travel with children or without.
